what: Each time a cell of the product strip stops at the center of the board, the hand drawing (before) swells to 1.04x on a 1.6 second bounce curve, then 1 second later shrinks to .3x while cloud pieces pop out with back.out(1.6) at .08 second intervals (.5s) and cover it. At the moment it clears, the cloud grows to 1.2x and vanishes in .4 seconds, and the photo (after) bounces in from .3x to be revealed. Ribbon, flower and heart decorations spin at the center of the board, fly into place (1.6s), and vanish in .3 seconds. It slides to the next cell with a .8 second back.out. One set is cloned to loop endlessly, and it pauses when off screen. It fires fx:cover, fx:reveal and fx:rest events on the board when covering, revealing and resting

ease.Bounce: Original table curve (overshoots up to 1.16 then settles)

options.stop: Pause computed value (sec) — rest = stop − cover − out, default 3
options.cover: Seconds from stop until the clouds cover, default 1
options.swap: Hand-drawing grow and photo reveal duration (s), default 1.6
options.burst: Decoration length baseline (seconds) — fly-off ×.8, vanish ×.15, default 2
options.grow: Hand-drawn scale of paused cell, default 1.04
options.ease: Turn curve — default back.out, "x1,y1,x2,y2" Surface CustomEase
options.--fx-item: Cell width (css variable), default 200px — cloud panel is the same size, decor panel is 1.35×1.28 and raised .14 upward
options.data-key: Per decoration piece "Rotation scale" — Starts from this rotation (deg) and scale at the panel center and settles at 0° and 1. If absent, 0° · 0x
